summary: The authors’ [full Figshare workbook](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.21842124.v1) supplied paired effects for 13,002 of 13,008 registered genes. Both concordance routes passed: Pearson was 0.9021, Spearman was 0.9888, and 98.25% of pairs agreed in direction. At FDR < 0.05, 828 discoveries were shared between 2,498 author calls and 847 registered calls. The proposal passed validation, and no ledger was edited.
openIssues: Maternal litter assignments remain unresolved for the ten offspring RNA profiles.
Full inferential reproduction requires the authors’ exact DESeq2 settings and raw P values. The proposal leaves full-verification sign-off empty.
